            // vpkstuff patch: every size above comes from the file. Check them against the
            // block before renting buffers sized by them: a few hundred hostile bytes could
            // otherwise ask for gigabytes (found by s2c fuzz). What is stored must fit in what
            // is left of the block (of the stream, for a standalone KV3 with Size 0), nothing may
            // be negative, and what it decompresses to may not exceed MaxUncompressedBytes
            // (vrf-kv3-read-limit). A ratio to the stored size cannot bound memory: a 454 KB zstd
            // block declaring 1.9 GB passed 4096x and peaked at 1.8 GB. A v5 zstd block's blob
            // frame is what the total leaves after buffers 1 and 2, so the total is what must fit.
            // The same decompressed size sets the node budget ReadBinaryValue enforces.
            {
                var remaining = Size > 0 ? Offset + Size - reader.BaseStream.Position
                    : reader.BaseStream.CanSeek ? reader.BaseStream.Length - reader.BaseStream.Position
                    : throw new InvalidDataException("A standalone KV3 needs a seekable stream so its sizes can be checked; refusing to parse.");
                var declared = (long)sizeUncompressedBuffer1 + sizeUncompressedBuffer2 + sizeBinaryBlobsBytes;
                var buffers = (long)sizeCompressedBuffer1 + sizeCompressedBuffer2;
                var zstdBlobs = version >= 5 && compressionMethod == KV3BinaryCompressionMethod.Zstd && countBlocks > 0;
                var stored = compressionMethod == KV3BinaryCompressionMethod.Uncompressed ? declared
                    : zstdBlobs ? sizeCompressedTotal
                    : version >= 5 ? buffers : sizeCompressedTotal;
                if (sizeUncompressedBuffer1 < 0 || sizeUncompressedBuffer2 < 0 || sizeBinaryBlobsBytes < 0
                    || sizeCompressedBuffer1 < 0 || sizeCompressedBuffer2 < 0 || sizeCompressedTotal < 0 || countBlocks < 0
                    || (zstdBlobs && buffers > sizeCompressedTotal) || stored > remaining)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException($"KV3 block declares {declared} bytes ({stored} stored) but holds {remaining}; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
                }

                var limit = MaxUncompressedBytes;
                if (declared > limit)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException($"KV3 block declares {declared} bytes, over the {limit}-byte limit; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
                }

                context.NodeBudget = (1 << 20) + 16L * declared;
            }

            // Before version 5, zstd stores the buffer and the binary blobs as two consecutive frames,
